description: Knotted the lashing, confirmed the flood, and delivered three stories.
name: Davy Gannet

description: Brought the delay from Somerset House and refused a share off the thin house.
name: John Heminges

description: Reported four shillings and tenpence and a yard of some sixty.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Called it the last play at the house, and took tomorrow without a new figure.
name: William Shakespeare
